mode: Mechanism-only formal heart geometry proof obligations, finite sweeps and isolated production pulse integration. No browser, live-game state, full-game batch, build, or source mutation.

requirement.text: - `AC-M10-02`：冲流确实推动感染体、暴露晶壳弱点，且不是只播放特效；碰撞后不会把敌人推入永久不可达区域。

structuralCertificate.interpretation: For every radius from 0 through maxRadius, expanded circular footprints are disjoint and strictly inside the shrunken rectangular center domain. The legal center space has one path-connected component, with holes; it is not simply connected.
structuralCertificate.projectionArgument: After translation, a correction onto one expanded circle cannot enter another disjoint expanded circle. If the final rectangular clamp changes a coordinate, its result lies on the rectangle boundary, outside every strictly interior disk. Thus each collision substep ends legal under these layout assumptions; all legal endpoints belong to the sole path component.
structuralCertificate.limit: An analytic argument checked through finite geometric inequalities and implementation review, not machine-checked formal verification or an enumeration of infinitely many positions.

finiteWholeWorldCollisionSweep.scope: Finite collision-implementation sweep across the entire formal heart, including all four outer edges/corners and all five fold rings. Most positions/directions are deliberate geometric stress fixtures outside the real device footprint; they are not claimed as executable pulse inputs or browser play.
finiteWholeWorldCollisionSweep.componentAttribution: Legal output points belong to the sole path-connected free-space component only under the separately checked structural certificate. The finite sweep alone does not prove connectedness or all continuous positions.

finiteConnectivityWitnesses.scope: Constructive finite visibility-graph witnesses from the actual heart spawn to facilities, outer corners and all five surrounding fold rings. Exact segment-circle clearance validates each edge; the global continuous-space claim still relies on the analytic certificate.

isolatedFormalDevicePulseIntegration.scope: Isolated unit fixtures instantiate the actual formal G3 heart and call the production BattleDirector.pulse method. Target positions and direction are intentionally arranged by the unit test. This proves code/geometry integration, not real browser E input, target spawn attainability, every possible pulse bearing, or human readability.

conclusions: For the exact recorded HEART_WORLD geometry and nonnegative body radii up to 52, disjoint strictly interior expanded circular obstacles leave one path-connected legal-center component. The five holes do not make a separate permanently unreachable component.

Under those geometric inequalities the current ordered projection and final rectangular clamp end each substep in legal center space. This is an implementation argument with numerical obligations checked here, not a machine-checked proof.

Finite stress cases independently exercise the real movement implementation throughout the full formal chamber. Device integration uses the real production pulse function and formal geometry with intentionally arranged target positions.
limitations: The finite sweep is not an enumeration of infinitely many positions or directions. The continuous-space conclusion depends on the stated geometric assumptions and implementation review.

This certificate is specific to the recorded formal heart layout; changing obstacle type, radius, order, geometry or collision algorithm requires revalidation. It makes no blanket claim about arbitrary or future maps.

Radius 52 is a conservative geometric check for the fixed core, not evidence that the core is displaced. Source radius 34 is excluded by production pulse rules; movable target radii are 14, 18, 22 and 30.

Most whole-world stress positions lie outside the real valve range. The separate device integration places targets directly as unit fixtures; it does not show natural encounter spawn attainability or actual browser E input.
No browser, renderer, ordinary full-game batch, FPS, native input, new-player readability, fun, retention or five-person blind-test conclusion follows from this report.

Legal endpoints and one shared path component prevent permanent geometric isolation; they do not certify line-of-sight from a single player position, target selection behavior, AI pathfinding quality, or a collision-free visual interpolation between sampled states.
